description: This Java source file defines the ContentBrowserActivity class for an Android application, demonstrating system UI flags, immersive content display, and tab management. It includes an inner class Content, which manages immersive mode toggling and UI visibility behaviors.

classes.name: ContentBrowserActivity
classes.description: Main activity demonstrating immersive UI and tab handling, containing inner class Content.

classes.name: Content
classes.description: Inner class extending ScrollView to implement immersive content display with UI flags and toggle behavior.

methods.name: ContentBrowserActivity.onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity UI, sets up tabs and content views.

methods.name: ContentBrowserActivity.onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates menu, sets up search and share action.

methods.name: ContentBrowserActivity.onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, toggling UI modes and tab visibility.

methods.name: Content.init
methods.description: Initializes the Content view with title and seek bar, and sets default UI visibility.

methods.name: Content.onSystemUiVisibilityChange
methods.description: Detects changes in system UI visibility to toggle immersive modes.

methods.name: Content.onWindowVisibilityChanged
methods.description: Shows navigation elements briefly when content becomes visible.

methods.name: Content.onScrollChanged
methods.description: Hides navigation elements when user scrolls.

methods.name: Content.onClick
methods.description: Toggles navigation UI visibility on user click.

methods.name: Content.setNavVisibility
methods.description: Sets system UI flags to show/hide navigation and updates visibility of title and seek bar.
